content:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Starlight (enterprise VPC) high 5xx rate observed in eu-west dedicated pool starlight-pool-eu-west at 14:02 UTC. Affected: model-serving endpoints for tenant starlight-prod. Sample error: 503 upstream timeout. Escalate to oncall.
Alex K: I'm on it. Looking at metrics now — QPS spiked ~3x and tail latency is 20s.
Maria T: @Alex K can you confirm which hosts are hitting OOM or networking errors?
Alex K: Logs show a bunch of `kv cache miss` churn and repeated model load retries: `failed to open mmap: resource temporarily unavailable`. Not seeing obvious OOM kills in kube events yet.
Evan L: I see network timeouts from the VPC proxy to the dedicated pool - many SYN retries. Could be LB or border NAT saturating.
Jessica R: Paging NetEng. We might need to shift customer traffic out of eu-west while we stabilize. DNS TTL is 60s for starlight's CNAME to dedicated pool.
NetEng: Investigating border NAT quotas and infra load in eu-west. Can you confirm target we want to shift to?
Alex K: Target: warm pool starlight-pool-eu-north-warm (reserved capacity). Verified compatible model variant present. Plan: change tenant CNAME to point to eu-north edge, then update routing in Redwood gateway to prefer warm pool.
Maria T: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm warm pool healthy 2) Pause new long-poll requests 3) Drain connections from problematic hosts 4) Cutover DNS 5) Verify end-to-end success.
Evan L: Warm pool health: all 8/8 nodes report OK, model load latency normal, KV cache primed for common prefixes. CPU/GPU utilization at 45%. Good to accept traffic.
Jessica R: I'll take DNS cutover. Steps: 1) set CNAME for starlight.example.com -> starlight-eu-north.edge.redwood.net 2) set TTL to 30 (already 60) 3) confirm propagation, 4) shift routing in gateway. I'll post commands.
Jessica R: Command (internal DNS provider):
```
nsupdate <<EOF
server ns1-dns
zone example.com
update delete starlight.example.com CNAME
update add starlight.example.com 60 CNAME starlight-eu-north.edge.redwood.net.
send
EOF
```
Alex K: Before you cut, we should put a short canary policy: route 10% of traffic for 5m -> eu-north, then 50% for 10m, then drain. Use `route_policy: canary(10,5m)->canary(50,10m)->full` in gateway.
NetEng: Noted. Also we'll pre-warm cloud NAT associations for eu-north so translations don't throttle.
Oncall Bot: Incident assignment: severity S2. Primary: Alex K, Secondary: Evan L. Notified oncall@redwood and NetEng channel.
Maria T: I'm adding a mitigation script to pause model loads on eu-west for starlight tenant to reduce pressure: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/tenants/starlight/actions/pause-model-loads`
Evan L: I've kicked the script. Observed immediate drop in new model load attempts on eu-west. Connection count down ~30%.
Jessica R: Starting DNS update in 2m. Posting monitor queries: `dig +short starlight.example.com @8.8.8.8` and `curl -v https://starlight.example.com/health`
Alex K: Reminder to keep KV cache warm on eu-north: running a small fanout of top 50 prefixes via `scripts/prime_cache.sh starlight eu-north` now.
Jessica R: DNS update pushed. Propagation showing eu-north IPs from major resolvers. Canary traffic policy applied via gateway.
Oncall Bot: Canary results: 10% traffic -> eu-north, error rate for those requests 0.4% vs 8.2% on eu-west. Latency good. Proceeding to 50% in 8m.
Alex K: 50% rolled. Watching for token errors and auth failures. No increase so far.
Evan L: NetEng reports NAT associations pre-warmed and no rate-limits.
Maria T: Draining connections from eu-west starlight pool: `kubectl cordon` + graceful drain on pods serving that tenant.
Jessica R: After 20m, full cutover complete. EU-west error rate for starlight now negligible. Rolling back pause-model-loads action.
Alex K: Confirmed: traffic fully shifted to eu-north, error rate back to baseline. Bringing up post-incident checklist: 1) root cause triage (border NAT saturation vs model load pattern) 2) improve alerting for KV cache churn 3) recommend lowering default DNS TTL for tenant CNAMEs to 30s for faster failover.
NetEng: We'll open a ticket to investigate NAT capacity bump and provide mitigation plan.
Jessica R: Notifying Starlight ops via their dedicated channel and sending post-cutover summary.
Oncall Bot: Incident S2 resolved at 14:52 UTC. Creating incident ticket INC-1976543210 for follow-up.
Alex K: Thanks team. I'll own RCA and follow up with runsheet updates and a short postmortem. :thumbsup:
Jessica R: Adding notes to runbook: explicit warm-pool DNS failover steps + example nsupdate and gateway policy snippets.
Maria T: Marking for postmortem review and adding action owners.
Evan L: I'll add a telemetry alert for sudden KV cache miss-rate > 25% for a tenant.
NetEng: I'll schedule NAT capacity test for eu-west and options for on-demand scale.
Oncall Bot: Closing thread record.
